descriptions.zh: 显然，[From.Planet.GetName]曾是一个高度发达的文明的家园。该星球等距环绕着的六颗卫星就足以证明这一点。但是行星目前已经化作一片废墟，整个恒星系都有着各种各样争斗的痕迹。这里到底发生了什么？
descriptions.en: [From.Planet.GetName] was clearly once home to a highly-advanced civilization; its six moons with orbits at equidistant intervals are evidence enough of that. However, the planet is in ruins and the entire star system shows signs of an extraordinarily violent struggle. What could have happened here?

sections.zh: 显然，[From.Planet.GetName]曾是一个高度发达的文明的家园。该星球等距环绕着的六颗卫星就足以证明这一点。但是行星目前已经化作一片废墟，整个恒星系都有着各种各样争斗的痕迹。这里到底发生了什么？

However, the planet is in ruins and the entire star system shows signs of an extraordinarily violent struggle. What could have happened here?

descriptions.zh: 我们找到了一艘设计独特的古代太空舰船的残骸。它使用的推进方式与现代舰船并不相同，而是依赖于在真空中展开的巨大的帆来进行。也许这艘船可以捕获恒星能量，并在星光和恒星风的推动下前进。我们的考古学家迫切希望揭开隐藏在这艘古老舰船中的秘密。
descriptions.en: We have found the wreckage of an archaic spaceship of unusual design. Instead of using propulsion similar to that of modern ships, the craft relied on large sails unfurled in the vacuum of space. Presumably, the ship harvested solar energy and drifted on the solar winds created by starlight. Our archaeologists are eager to uncover the secrets concealed within this spacecraft.

descriptions.zh:
深空中出现了一具远古实体的尸骸。它的外形与任何已知的活体舰船都不同，具有巨大的膜状帆，可以在宇宙风中徐徐涨开，乘着遥远繁星的辐射，化身在不可见的洋流中翱翔的星际巨兽。

如今，它不过是一句干枯的尸体，骨架破裂裸露在外，曾经光彩熠熠的帆膜破烂不堪。目前尚不确定这个生物是被设计出来的还是进化而来，亦或是介于两者之间。生物考古学家们渴望研究这具遗骸，去倾听它终末旅程的回响，也许，只是也许，学习它曾经对着群星所唱出的歌谣。
descriptions.en:
The drifting remains of an ancient entity have been discovered in the depths of space. Its form is unlike any living vessel we have known, it possesses vast, membranous sails, once capable of unfurling in the cosmic winds, basking in the radiation of distant stars like a great celestial leviathan gliding on unseen currents.

Now, it is little more than a withered husk, its frame cracked and exposed, its once-lustrous sails reduced to tattered remnants. Whether this being was engineered, evolved, or something in between remains uncertain. Our bio-archeologists are eager to study its remains, to listen for echoes of its final journey, and perhaps, just perhaps, to learn the song it once sang to the stars.

descriptions.zh:
我们在星球各地都发现了水的迹象。据我们所知，这些水应该还在这颗星球上。星球温度在液态水存在的正常范围内，并且星球仍然存在大气，尽管很脆弱。然而，这里的一切都是干燥的，存在的植被也枯死了。

此外，扫描还揭示了行星上另一个星际文明的踪迹。考古团队将有两个目标：找出水发生了什么，并了解其他星际旅者在这里做了什么。大多数假设已经将两者联系起来，团队中的一些人认为这可能是“偷水贼”干的。
descriptions.en:
We have found signs of water all over this world. For all we know, it should still be here. The temperatures are within the normal range for liquid water to exist, and there is still an atmosphere, albeit tenuous. And yet, everything here is dry and what vegetation exists is parched.

In addition, scans have revealed traces of another spacefaring civilization on the planet. The archaeological team will have two goals: find out what happened to the water and understand what other spacefarers have been doing here. Most hypotheses are already linking the two and some in the team believe that this might have been the work of 'water thieves'.

descriptions.zh: [From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系中孤零零的这颗行星上住满了无人机。它们对我们毫不关心，各自匆匆忙忙做着自己的事情。如果关于这个奇怪的星系有什么线索的话一定能在那里找到。
descriptions.en: The sole planet in the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system is bustling with drones. Heedless of us, they continue to perform their tasks. If the answers to this curious system are to be found anywhere, it is here.

sections.zh: [From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系中孤零零的这颗行星上住满了无人机。它们对我们毫不关心，各自匆匆忙忙做着自己的事情。如果关于这个奇怪的星系有什么线索的话一定能在那里找到。
sections.en: The sole planet in the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system is bustling with drones. Heedless of us, they continue to perform their tasks. If the answers to this curious system are to be found anywhere, it is here.

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家在[From.Planet.GetName]发现了一些奇怪的东西。作为一颗热带星球，其表面大片区域被茂密的丛林覆盖：巨大的、寿达千年的古树从林冠中突兀而起，它们枝叶茂密的树冠俯瞰着其他陆上景观。

初看起来，这些参天大树的分布似乎杂乱无章。然而，更详细的分析表明这些树的分布具有数学精准性，也许是由某个消失已久的文明所种植的。不仅如此，团队领袖相信，树木的分布方式可能包含着一组坐标，指向丛林深处某个未被探索的区域。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists have discovered something unusual on [From.Planet.GetName]. A tropical world, much of the planet's surface is covered with dense jungle: massive, thousand year old trees erupt from the canopy, their leafy crowns towering over the landscape.

At first glance, the distribution of these giants appears random. However, further analysis indicates that the trees are arranged with mathematical precision, and it seems likely they were planted by some long-vanished civilization. What's more, the team leader believes the distribution pattern may comprise a set of coordinates, one that points to an unexplored location deep within the jungle.

descriptions.zh: 整个[From.Planet.GetName]的地表遍布死亡缇扬奇的遗骸。我们的传感器没有检测到生命的信号，然而这些尸体仍然在不停地蠕动，仿佛有什么看不见的力在驱动这些尸体一样。
descriptions.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is entirely covered in the remains of dead Tiyanki. Our sensors detect no signs of life, and yet the corpses still writhe and squirm, as if animated by some inscrutable force.

sections.en: The surface of [From.Planet.GetName] is entirely covered in the remains of dead Tiyanki. Our sensors detect no signs of life, and yet the corpses still writhe and squirm, as if animated by some inscrutable force.

descriptions.zh: [from.planet.GetName]上辽阔的冰冻荒原曾一度遍布汪洋，水面之下处处是深海火山峡谷。尽管其环境已经无法继续支持生命，我们还是在一处靠近地表的冰封堑道内发现了一些年代久远的水下定居点。
descriptions.en: The vast, frozen wastelands of [from.planet.GetName] were once seas, spread atop an abundance of deep volcanic canyons. Though the environment is no longer capable of supporting life, we have detected the ruins of ancient submarine settlements in icebound trenches close to the planet's surface.

descriptions.zh: [from.planet.GetName]乍一看是一颗普通的宜居行星，但我们的研究团队详细调查后发现了许多大型的化石矿藏，而且保存状况相当良好。有趣的是，一些大型的化石群在同一地层中包含许多物种，这表明要么它们是在同一时间死去，要么就是被人刻意这样安置的。对这些遗骸的检测让我们有机会进一步了解这颗行星上生活的物种的进化轨迹。
descriptions.en: [from.planet.GetName] appears to be a standard habitable planet, but on closer inspection, our research team has spotted large deposits of fossils in seemingly well-preserved conditions. Interestingly, larger clusters contain multiple specimens on the same layer, indicating that they either died at the same time or were placed there intentionally. Examination of these remains gives us the opportunity to better understand the evolutionary process of the species inhabiting this planet.

descriptions.zh: 我们对[From.Planet.System.GetName]恒星系的扫描显示，它的小行星带是一种非同寻常的类型。与通常组成这类结构的岩石、冰块加太空垃圾的大杂烩不同，它看起来像是许多大型的人造居住站所形成的残骸。这显然是在过去几千年内的某个时间被难以想象的暴力所摧毁的。这片残骸场中必然潜藏着许多不为人知的秘密，但由于体量巨大，进行测绘就需要花费挺长的时间。
descriptions.en: Our scans of the [From.Planet.System.GetName] system show that its asteroid belt is of an unusual variety. Instead of the standard mix of rocks, ice and space rubble that usually make up such formations, it seems to be the remains of a number of large, artificial habitats. These must have been destroyed with incredible violence sometime in the last few millennia. Untold secrets may be contained within the resulting debris field, but it is so extensive that charting it out could take quite some time.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]上发现了一座古城的废墟。通过它的大小和规模发现它很可能是一个星际文明的首都或主要空间居住地。

为了了解这座废墟的起源，我们需要全面挖掘。
descriptions.en:
We've discovered the ruins of an ancient city on [From.Planet.GetName]. Given its size and scale, this was likely the capital or central administrative hub of a major space-faring civilization.

A full excavation will be necessary to properly determine its origin.
